name: concurrent-readback
expression: (async()=>{if(document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Stop assistant response"]'))throw Error('Still active');const {useStudio}=await import('/src/studio/store.ts');const {readChatArchive}=await import('/src/studio/assistant/chatHistory.ts');const job=useStudio.getState().job;const archive=await readChatArchive(job.id);return {job,archive,text:document.body.innerText,choiceButtons:[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].filter(b=>/governing source|locked two-point|read_workflow_route|read_project_context|read_source_sheets|Actual roof geometry|Decision owner|Stated dimensions/.test(b.innerText)).map(b=>b.innerText),errors:[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=alert]')].map(x=>x.innerText)};})()
